entities.name: Maven Clinic
entities.how_described: 本集嘉宾 Dan 所在的公司：一家专注于孕产、生育、育儿、更年期的大型数字健康平台，两年内从传统科技公司转型为 AI 原生公司，并构建了跨产品的编排层 Maven Intelligence。

evidence.quote: I'm from Maven Clinic.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: AI 原生 (AI native)
entities.how_described: 本集核心主题：没有单一定义、没有现成 playbook，Dan 把它归结为三件事——内部能用 AI 就用 AI、把 AI 构建进产品（改善体验+降低成本）、改文化流程以最大化 AI 价值。

evidence.quote: So first of all, I don't think there's one single definition what it means by AI native.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: You can just follow and bingo, you become AI native.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: AI 编程工具 (AI coding tools)
entities.how_described: 本集称之为可能是最成功的 AI 应用。Maven 的路径是从写单元测试和文档这类低风险任务起步建立信心，再到规则、技能和护栏，最后推广到全团队；如今几乎所有实现都由它完成，工程师专注审查、架构和评估。

evidence.quote: AI coding tools is probably the most successful AI application.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And then we push to the whole engineer team, say, now you should use this AI coding tools for all the tasks.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And at this moment, we pretty much use the AI coding tools to do all our implementation.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So, and with AI coding tools, we are writing so much code these days.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: For example, last year, most of folks at Maven, they are using Cursor.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 代码审查 (code review)
entities.how_described: 本集说 AI 编程让代码量从每天几百行涨到上千行，代码审查成了瓶颈；Maven 重构了制度：允许工程师自行判断是否需要人审、PR 不超 500 行、启用堆叠式 PR，坚决避免『橡皮图章』式假审查。

evidence.quote: Code review becomes really challenging.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: If we're capable to do the code review as we used to do, we won't be able to keep up.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: That means we need to really change the way we are doing code review to meet where we are now.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: One is we allow engineers to self-identify whether we still need code review.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And if they do want code review, we want them to stay with the best practices.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Do a meaningful code review with the ones that has like thousands of less code.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: It means people submit code review.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Meanwhile, we should keep working on our AI code review tools, because we think that's the future.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 幻觉 (hallucination)
entities.how_described: 本集说生成式 AI 的幻觉消不干净、完全消除成本高也没必要；正确做法是分层：区分可豁免与不可豁免的失败，高风险场景用不同模型交叉验证同一收据，判断不了就转人工，再配严格的集成测试与上线后人工抽查。

evidence.quote: But for the GNI solutions, hallucination is there.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: This whole process makes sure we feel really confident we never reach something, although we know hallucination is there.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 护栏 (guardrails)
entities.how_described: 本集提到 Maven 在建立信心后开始构建自己的规则、技能并建立护栏。

evidence.quote: And we start to construct our own rules, skills, and build our guardrails.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 招聘 (hire)
entities.how_described: 本集说 AI 擅长执行，所以招聘要变：新人必须能独立解决问题，公司已无法承担分派实现任务的模式；要找真正对 AI 感兴趣、懂产品、能处理复杂模糊问题的人。

evidence.quote: So let's change how we should hire new people and how should we reward it.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Also, when we hire new people, we should think about what we are looking for.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: When we hire new people, this is also the people we are interested in bringing on boards.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 迭代周期 (sprint)
entities.how_described: 本集说季度规划死了、论证才是贵的：一年目标只当方向，真正聚焦未来两到四周的 sprint，周期结束就发布，发现方向错了就快速换挡；文档只写一两页供沟通迭代。

evidence.quote: What we want to get the PMs and designers to say, OK, tell me what I need to do in this sprint.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: And the engineer will focus on it and get it released at the end of the sprint if not sooner.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: If under this sprint, they say, no, what we decided 2xGo is wrong, it's totally OK. We can switch the gear, get it fixed quickly.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00
